questions.question: Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and make the given equation correct. 63 * 90 * 42 * 230 * 46 * 3
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and make the given equation correct.

63 * 90 * 42 * 230 * 46 * 3
questions.solution:
BODMAS rule:

Given equation: 63 * 90 * 42 * 230 * 46 * 3 

After replacing the *'s by the sequence of mathematical signs in each option, we get:

1. =, ×, +, ÷, – 

63 = 90 × 42 + 230 ÷ 46 - 3 

63 = 90 × 42 + 5 - 3

63 = 3780 + 5 - 3

63 = 3785 - 3

63 ≠ 3782

2. +, ÷, –, =, ×

63 + 90 ÷ 42 - 230 = 46 × 3

63 + 2.14 - 230 = 46 × 3

63 + 2.14 - 230 = 138

65.14 - 230 = 138

-164.86 ≠ 138

3. =, –, +, ÷, ×

63 = 90 - 42 + 230 ÷ 46 × 3

63 = 90 - 42 + 5 × 3

63 = 90 - 42 + 15

63 = 105 - 42

63 = 63

4. ×, ÷, =, –, +

63 × 90 ÷ 42 = 230 - 46 + 3

63 × 2.14 = 230 - 46 + 3

134.82 = 230 - 46 + 3

134.82 = 233 - 46

134.82 ≠ 187

Hence, '=, –, +, ÷, ×' is the correct answer.

questions.question: The 40 th Amendment Act of 1976 was applied to which Article of the Constitution of India?
questions.questionHtml: The 40<sup>th</sup> Amendment Act of 1976 was applied to which Article of the Constitution of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Article 297.

  • The 40th Amendment Act of 1976 was applied to Article 297 of the constitution of India.

Key Points

  • According to the  40th Amendment Act of 1976:
    • For Article 297 of the Constitution, the following article shall be substituted, namely:-
      • Article 297(3).
      • Article297(2)
      • Article 297(1)
    • ​These articles empowered the Parliament to specify ​from time to time,
    • the limits of the territorial waters, the continental shelf, the Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ), and the maritime zones of India.
  • 40th Amendment 1976, also included 64 more Central and state laws.
  • Mostly relating to land reforms in the 9th Schedule.

Additional Information

  •  Article 248
    • It deals with the residuary powers of legislation.
    • It states that parliament has exclusive power to make any law with respect to any matter not enumerated in the Concurrent List or State List.
  • Article 245​
    • ​Article 245 of the Indian constitution talks about the extent of laws made by Parliament and by the Legislatures of States.
    • It gives Parliament the power to make laws and also gives the legislative body the power to repeal them.
  • Article 226
    • ​Article 226 of the Constitution empowers the Hon'ble High Courts to exercise power through the issuance of writs:
      • Habeas Corpus
      • Mandamus
      • Quo Warranto
      • Prohibition and certiorari or any appropriate writ.

questions.question: What is the study of the production and propagation of sound waves called?
questions.questionHtml: What is the study of the production and propagation of sound waves called?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Acoustics.

Key Points

  • Acoustics is the study of the production and propagation of sound waves.
  • Acoustics is the science concerned with the production, control, transmission, reception, and effects of sound.
  • The term is derived from the Greek akoustos, meaning “heard.”
  •  Applications of acoustic technology are in the study of:
    • Geologic,
    • Atmospheric,
    • Underwater phenomena.​

Additional Information

  • Optics
    • ​Optics is the branch of physics which is concerned with light and its behavioural pattern and properties.
    • Optics is a branch of physics that deals with the determination of behaviour and the properties of light,
    • It also studies the interactions of light with the matter and also with the instruments which are used to detect it.
  • Photonics
    • ​Photonics is the physical science of light waves.
    • It deals with the science behind the generation, detection and manipulation of light.
    • Light has a dual nature known as the wave-particle duality. 
  • Astrophysics
    • ​Astrophysics is a branch of space science that applies the laws of physics and chemistry to seek to understand the universe.
    • The field explores topics such as the birth, life and death of stars, planets, galaxies, nebulae and other objects in the universe.

questions.question: ‘Ashtadhyayi’, written by Sanskrit scholar Panini, is a book on ______.
questions.questionHtml: ‘Ashtadhyayi’, written by Sanskrit scholar Panini, is a book on ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is grammar.

  • Ashtadhyayi was written by Indian grammarian Panini during the 6th to 5th century BCE. 

Key Points 

  • Ashtadhyayi sets the work standard for the Sanskrit language. 
  • It sums up in 4,000 sutras that had evolved in the Vedic religion.
  • Panini divided his work into eight chapters, each of which is further divided into quarter chapters.
  • Beyond defining the morphology and syntax of Sanskrit language, Ashtadhyayi distinguishes between usage in the spoken language and usage that is proper to the language of the sacred texts.

Additional Information 

  • Vedavyasa: He is the author of Mahabharata.
  • Shukadeva: He is the main narrator of Bhagavata Purana.
  • Valmiki: He is the author of the epic Ramayana.

questions.question: As per the Economic Survey of India 2020-21, India is expected to have a Current Account Surplus of ______ GDP in FY21.
questions.questionHtml: As per the Economic Survey of India 2020-21, India is expected to have a Current Account Surplus of ______  GDP in FY21.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 2%.

Key Points

  • India is expected to have a Current Account Surplus of 2 percent of GDP in FY21, a historic high after 17 years.
  • Summary of Economic Survey-2020-21
    • India’s real GDP to record an 11.0% growth in FY2021-22 and nominal GDP to grow by 15.4% – the highest since independence.
    • The recovery in the second half of FY2020-21 is expected to be powered by government consumption, estimated to grow at 17% YoY.
    • Exports are expected to decline by 5.8% and imports by 11.3% in the second half of FY21.
    • India expected to have a Current Account Surplus of 2% of GDP in FY21, a historic high after 17 years.
    • On the supply side, Gross Value Added (GVA) growth was pegged at -7.2% in FY21 as against 3.9% in FY20.
    • Agriculture is set to cushion the shock of the COVID-19 pandemic on the Indian economy in FY21 with a growth of 3.4%.
    • Industry and services are estimated to contract by 9.6% and 8.8% respectively during FY21.
    • Agriculture remained the silver lining while contact-based services, manufacturing, and construction were hit hardest, and recovering steadily.
    • India remained a preferred investment destination in FY 2020-21 with FDI pouring in amidst global asset shifts towards equities and prospects of quicker recovery in emerging economies.
    • Net FPI inflows recorded an all-time monthly high of US$ 9.8 billion in November 2020, as investors’ risk appetite returned.
    • India was the only country among emerging markets to receive equity FII inflows in 2020.​

Additional Information

  • Current Account Surplus
    • ​A current account surplus is a positive current account balance, indicating that a nation is a net lender to the rest of the world.
    • A current account surplus will tend to boost domestic employment if:
      • It is due to an improvement in competitiveness.
      • Leading to higher demand for exports.
      • If domestic demand is still relatively strong, consumers are buying domestic goods, rather than importing.

questions.question: If \(\sqrt x \) - \(\frac{1}{{\sqrt x }}\) = \({\sqrt 3 }\) , then what is the value of \({x^4}\) + \(\frac{1}{{{x^4}}}\) ?
questions.questionHtml: If \(\sqrt x \) - \(\frac{1}{{\sqrt x }}\) = \({\sqrt 3 }\), then what is the value of \({x^4}\) + \(\frac{1}{{{x^4}}}\)?
questions.solution:
Formula:

(x - y)2 = x2 + y2 - 2xy

Calculations:

√x - \(1\over √x\) = √3

Squaring both sides, we get-

⇒ (√x)2 + (\(1\over √x\))2 - 2 × \(\sqrt x\)  × \(1\over √x\) = (√3)2

⇒ x + \(1\over x\) - 2 = 3

⇒ x + \(1\over x\) = 5

Squaring both sides, we get-

⇒ x2 + \(1\over x^2\) + 2 = 25

⇒ x2 + \(1\over x^2\) = 23

Squaring both sides, we get-

⇒ x4 + \(1\over x^4\) + 2 = 529

⇒ x4 + \(1\over x^4\) = 527

The answer for the expression is 527.

Shortcut Trick If √x - \(1\over √x\) = √3 = p, then x + \(\frac{1}{x}\) = p2 + 2 = (√3)2 + 2 = 5 = k (Let)

If  x + \(\frac{1}{x}\) = k = 5, then x2 + \(\frac{1}{x^2}\) = k2 - 2 = 52 - 2 = 23 m (Let)

 x2 + \(\frac{1}{x^2}\) = m = 23, then x4 + \(\frac{1}{x^4}\) = m2 - 2 = (23)2 - 2 = 527

questions.question: The area of similar triangles PQR and MNT are 196 cm 2 and 169 cm 2 respectively. If the longest side of the larger Δ PQR be 28 cm then what is the length (in cm) of the longest side of the smaller Δ MNT?
questions.questionHtml: The area of similar triangles PQR and MNT are 196 cm<sup>2</sup> and 169 cm<sup>2</sup> respectively. If the longest side of the larger Δ PQR be 28 cm then what is the length (in cm) of the longest side of the smaller Δ MNT?
questions.solution:
Given data:

Δ PQR area = 196 cm2

Δ MNT area = 169 cm2

Longest side of PQR = 28 cm

Concept used:

According to the Similarity theorem, two triangles are said to be similar, if their sides are in equal proportion along with their corresponding angles. The area of the similar triangle would also be in proportion to the square of their similar sides.

Hence, if Δ ABC ~ Δ DEF

⇒ \(AB^2 \over DE^2 \) = \(ar Δ ABC \over ar Δ DEF\) 

Calculations:

Longest side of PQR i.e, PR = 28 cm

From the similarity theorem,

⇒ \(PR^2\over MT^2\) = \(ar PQR\over ar MNT\) 

Taking the square root of both the sides -

⇒ \(28 \over MT\) = \(14\over 13\)

⇒ MT = 26 cm

∴ The length of the largest side of the smallest triangle Δ MNT is 26 cm.

In Δ OCP, ∠OCP + ∠OPC + ∠COP = 180º

Since ∠BCO = ∠CBO (formed from same radius)

From the figure, ∠PCB = 90º – ∠BCO

⇒ ∠PCB = 90º – 64º = 26º

∴ The measure of ∠PCB is 26º.

questions.question: The average of a set of 18 consecutive integers is 22.5. What is the largest integer in the set?
questions.questionHtml: The average of a set of 18 consecutive integers is 22.5. What is the largest integer in the set?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

For consecutive integers, the Average lies exactly at the mid-point of the series.

Largest Integer = Average + (n − 1) ÷ 2

Largest Integer = 22.5 + (18 − 1) ÷ 2 = 22.5 + 8.5 = 31

∴ The correct answer is 31.

Alternate Method

Given: Number of terms (n) = 18, Average = 22.5

Formula: Average of AP = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2

⇒ Let the 18 consecutive integers be x, x+1, ..., x+17.

⇒ 22.5 = (x + x + 17) ÷ 2

⇒ 22.5 × 2 = 2x + 17

⇒ 45 = 2x + 17

⇒ 2x = 45 − 17 = 28

⇒ x = 14 (Smallest integer)

⇒ Largest integer = x + 17 = 14 + 17 = 31

∴ The correct answer is 31.

Additional Information

Consecutive Integers Average

For any Arithmetic Progression (AP), the average is always the middle term (if n is odd) or the mean of the two middle terms (if n is even).

Smallest and Largest Relation

The difference between the largest and smallest of n consecutive integers is always (n − 1).

Sum of Consecutive Integers

Sum = Average × Number of terms = [n ÷ 2] × [2a + (n − 1)d].

questions.solution:
Given data:

PQ = 12 cm

QS = 3 cm

QR = 7 cm

Concept used:

According to the angular bisector property of the triangle, the angular bisector divides the opposite sides in a proportion equal to the remaining sides.

In Δ ABC, BD is the angular bisector and \({AD\over DC} = {AB\over BC}\)

Calculations:

From the figure, 

SR = QR - QS

⇒ SR = 7 - 3 = 4 cm

In Δ PQR using angular bisector theorem, we get

\({PQ\over PR} = {QS\over SR}\)   

⇒ \({12\over PR} = {3\over 4}\)

⇒ PR = 16 cm.

The length of PR is 16 cm.

questions.solution: It is in the simple present tense. In order to convert the active voice of simple present tense to passive voice, we use the following structure:​Object + is/am/are + V3 + by + object. The sentence formed will be: 'It is time for the syllabi to be revised.'Therefore, option 1 is the correct answer.

Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

They each listened carefully to what each other said.
questions.solution: The improvement required in the sentence is that 'each other' is to be replaced with 'the other'. This is to be done because each has already been used in the beginning of the sentence. We will thus not use each again with other. Improved sentence: They each listened carefully to what the other said.

questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'a significant'.

Key Points

  • In the first sentence, we can observe that in the interactive process of business transactions, listening is important.
  • It plays a significant role.
  • We will thus use the phrase 'a significant'  to fill in the blank 1.
  • Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

So the complete passage is- Listening plays (1) a significant role in the interactive process of business transactions. It enables a person to gather proper and (2) accurate information so that he can understand the matter with clarity. For this, he should have a positive attitude towards the speaker and the (3) topic. He should also (4) concentrate on what is being spoken and then evaluate it with reference to the (5) context.

    • For eg.- Accurate information about the illness is essential.
  • We will thus use the word 'accurate' to fill in the blank 2.
  • Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.

So the complete passage is- Listening plays (1) a significant role in the interactive process of business transactions. It enables a person to gather proper and (2) accurate information so that he can understand the matter with clarity. For this, he should have a positive attitude towards the speaker and the (3) topic. He should also (4) concentrate on what is being spoken and then evaluate it with reference to the (5) context.

vague of uncertain, indefinite, or unclear character or meaning. Many patients suffer vague symptoms.

  • Context: the circumstances that form the setting for an event, statement, or idea, and in terms of which it can be fully understood.
    • For eg.- The proposals need to be considered in the context of new European directives.
  • We will thus use the word 'context' to fill in the blank 5.
  • Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

So the complete passage is- Listening plays (1) a significant role in the interactive process of business transactions. It enables a person to gather proper and (2) accurate information so that he can understand the matter with clarity. For this, he should have a positive attitude towards the speaker and the (3) topic. He should also (4) concentrate on what is being spoken and then evaluate it with reference to the (5) context.
